body_html:
JAMMIN’ DJs Videos

JAMMIN’ DJs videos give you a quick look at the energy, music, lighting, production, and guest experience we bring to real events. From weddings and Bar and Bat Mitzvahs to school dances, trivia nights, photo booth events, and special effects, these videos help you see what JAMMIN’ DJs can add to your celebration.

Every event has a different feel. Because of that, our team customizes the music, MC style, lighting, timeline, and entertainment options around the client, venue, crowd, and event goals.

See JAMMIN’ DJs in Action

Browse the videos below to see examples of our wedding entertainment, school dance productions, mitzvah parties, JAMMIN’ Sparks, trivia events, and photo booth experiences. In addition, you can visit our YouTube channel for more recent event videos and entertainment content.

Watch more JAMMIN’ DJs videos on YouTube

JAMMIN’ Weddings Demo

See how JAMMIN’ DJs helps couples create smooth receptions, packed dance floors, polished announcements, and memorable wedding moments.

JAMMIN’ Sparks

JAMMIN’ Sparks can create a dramatic effect for grand entrances, first dances, dance floor moments, and special event highlights where permitted by the venue and local regulations.

JAMMIN’ Schools Demo

Our school dance videos show the sound, lighting, music, and student energy JAMMIN’ DJs can bring to proms, homecomings, pep rallies, winter formals, and student celebrations.

JAMMIN’ Trivia

JAMMIN’ Trivia gives restaurants, bars, corporate events, and private parties a fun way to keep guests involved. Our hosts keep the game moving, explain the rules, and create a lively event experience.

JAMMIN’ Sparks Demo

This demo shows another example of how sparks can add visual excitement to weddings, mitzvahs, school events, corporate events, and private celebrations when the effect is approved for the venue.

JAMMIN’ Bar & Bat Mitzvah

Our Bar and Bat Mitzvah videos show how JAMMIN’ DJs combines music, MC services, games, dancers, lighting, and party flow to keep kids engaged and adults included.

JAMMIN’ Mitzvah & Photo Booth

This video highlights mitzvah entertainment and photo booth options that give guests more ways to participate, laugh, take pictures, and enjoy the celebration.

Plan Your Event Entertainment

If you are planning a wedding, Bar or Bat Mitzvah, school dance, corporate event, trivia night, photo booth rental, or private celebration, JAMMIN’ DJs can help you build the right entertainment package.
